title: PANTHEON faculties and AETHER bounded research swarm staged
summary: A branch-isolated PANTHEON/AETHER integration now implements independent falsification, identifiability, structural-reachability, ontology-surprise, causal-debt, research-question, monetization, and authority-arbitration faculties plus a bounded ephemeral swarm. The design preserves ORACLE, PARALLAX and DREAMSTATE ownership, retains engine disagreement instead of forced consensus, uses blind first-pass information partitions for mandatory adversarial/provenance/risk roles, keeps a lightweight asset/horizon sentinel-cell registry, and surfaces the fabric in the ICARUS trader interface. All new authority remains research/shadow only pending exact-head CI and merge.
